_notes: Sensirion SCD30 CO2/temperature/humidity at 0x61. No detection values: 0x61 is in the RSAO identification hook's probe range, and a detection that could fail would let the hook send it framed bytes (as the STCC4, devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md). Init: firmware version (0xD100), then read the measurement interval (0x4600) and the ASC setting (0x5306), start continuous measurement with no pressure compensation (0x0010 0x0000), then set the interval to 2 s and ASC off - each only if it differs ({?setInterval}, {?setAsc} guards computed by initCode), as both are stored in the sensor's non-volatile memory. Commands are followed by a pause before the read (the SCD30 needs 3 ms). Poll: data-ready (0x0202) twice, then read measurement (0x0300): CO2, T and RH as big-endian floats, each 2-byte half followed by a CRC.
